content.short: Automated, non-custodial yield optimization on Solana with AI-driven pool analytics.
content.description: WealthVille is an automated, non-custodial yield optimization platform for Solana. It uses AI-driven pool analytics to help users evaluate DeFi opportunities, with tools for pool intelligence, yield analysis, automated compounding, and portfolio monitoring. Its research explains how concentrated-liquidity mechanics such as CLMM tick ranges affect liquidity positions, fees, and impermanent loss.
